geographic_scope: South Mumbai (city-level for RBI HPI; South Mumbai bounding box for OSM)
data_integrity_statement: Urban transformation is a complex socio-economic process. UrbanLens does NOT label any area as 'gentrifying' based solely on housing price index or amenity count data. The indicators presented are descriptive only. All data limitations are documented transparently.

indicators.name: 15-Year Cumulative Housing Price Growth
indicators.methodology: Total percentage change in quarterly HPI points from base quarter Q1 2010–11 to Q4 2024–25.
indicators.interpretation: Substantial long-term capital appreciation across registered transactions in Mumbai metropolitan area.
limitations: Metropolitan city-level aggregate; does not reflect micro-market ward variations.
Index points (dimensionless), not absolute INR/sqft valuation.

indicators.name: 5-Year Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
indicators.methodology: Compound annual growth rate across the most recent 20 quarters.
indicators.interpretation: Medium-term price momentum following post-2020 urban market expansion.

indicators.name: Rolling Quarterly Price Volatility
indicators.methodology: Average 8-quarter rolling sample standard deviation of quarterly QoQ growth rates.
indicators.interpretation: Captures cyclical volatility and valuation stability over multi-year windows.

indicators.name: Ward-Level Residential Property Prices
indicators.unavailability_reason: No official Indian government portal publishes ward-level transaction prices in open formats.
indicators.potential_proxy: IGR Maharashtra ready reckoner rates (requires institutional data agreement).
limitations: Private portals (Magicbricks/99acres) lack open licensing and representative transaction verification.

indicators.name: Decennial Population Density Change
indicators.unavailability_reason: Census of India 2021 was delayed and official municipal ward tables remain unreleased.
indicators.potential_proxy: Static 2011 Census Mumbai tables (historical reference only, cannot represent current trend).
limitations: Demographic simulation without raw enumeration would violate academic integrity.

indicators.name: Average Household Size & Composition Shift
indicators.unavailability_reason: Ward-level household structure updates require 2021 Census or local municipal surveys.
indicators.potential_proxy: PLFS urban Maharashtra survey (sample too coarse for neighborhood resolution).
limitations: Not available at municipal ward level.

indicators.name: Civic Amenity Density (South Mumbai Snapshot)
indicators.methodology: Total verified OSM civic amenities divided by cumulative bounding-box sub-region area (~37.78 km²).
indicators.interpretation: High baseline civic amenity clustering in historic urban core of South Mumbai.
limitations: Point-in-time snapshot only; historical infrastructure growth velocity cannot be inferred.
Contributor mapping bias towards parking facilities and commercial landmarks.

indicators.name: Historical Civic Infrastructure Expansion Rate
indicators.unavailability_reason: OSM historical full-history dumps require gigabyte-scale temporal parsing not currently integrated.
indicators.potential_proxy: Overpass temporal API queries for historical node creation timestamps (rate limited).
limitations: Node creation in OSM reflects when a volunteer mapped it, not when the physical building was constructed.

indicators.name: New Construction Permits (IOD / CC Approvals)
indicators.unavailability_reason: MCGM building approvals are behind an architect portal without an open REST API.
indicators.potential_proxy: MCGM Development Plan 2034 GIS layers (PDF reports only).
limitations: Legal restrictions on unauthorized portal scraping.

indicators.name: Slum Redevelopment Authority (SRA) Scheme Footprint
indicators.unavailability_reason: SRA publishes project lists as non-vector PDF scans lacking GIS polygon coordinates.
indicators.potential_proxy: Manual digitization of SRA gazette notices.
limitations: Manual digitization is resource-intensive and unvalidated.

indicators.name: Residential Rent-to-Income Burden
indicators.unavailability_reason: No official residential rental index exists in India; ward-level household income surveys are unavailable.
indicators.potential_proxy: NSSO / PLFS district-level consumption expenditure tables.
limitations: Coarse sampling error when applied to micro-markets.

indicators.name: Tenant Displacement Pressure Score
indicators.unavailability_reason: Displacement cannot be empirically calculated without eviction records, tenure data, and longitudinal rent surveys.
indicators.potential_proxy: Civil court eviction filings (unstructured public legal records).
limitations: Fabricating a displacement score without eviction data violates ethical standards.

indicators.name: Centroid 500m Walkability Catchment
indicators.methodology: Count of verified OSM amenity nodes situated within <= 0.5 km of sub-region centroid.
indicators.interpretation: Moderate-to-high pedestrian access to civic amenities within 6-minute walk.
limitations: Euclidean/Haversine spherical distance; does not model pedestrian network topology.

indicators.name: Centroid 1.0 km Transit Catchment
indicators.methodology: Count of verified OSM amenity nodes within <= 1.0 km of sub-region centroid.
indicators.interpretation: Substantial civic node coverage within 12-minute micro-transit catchment.

indicators.name: Ward Household Income Distribution Shift
indicators.unavailability_reason: No official ward-level personal income or wealth statistics exist in India.
indicators.potential_proxy: Vehicle registrations or electricity consumption by municipal division.
limitations: Electricity tax records require RTI or official municipal sharing.

indicators.name: Multispectral Urban Canopy Change (NDVI)
indicators.methodology: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red).
indicators.unavailability_reason: Heavy monsoon cloud cover (June–Sept) and compute bounds exceed local 8 GB RAM offline environment.
indicators.potential_proxy: Google Earth Engine cloud-native computation (future Milestone).
limitations: High cloud cover in coastal Mumbai.
